statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-69806 is an elevation of privilege issue in the .NET SDK's dotnet watch: its Aspire server service (AspireServerService) exposes information through certain arguments, which can enable code injection. Microsoft's advisory lists Linux installations of the .NET 9 SDK in the 9.0.3xx feature band (9.0.300 through 9.0.316, fixed in 9.0.317) as the affected .NET 9 SDKs, and does not list the 9.0.1xx band (https://github.com/dotnet/sdk/issues/56167, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/442). The CVE record names the .NET 9.0 runtime before 9.0.20 as the affected product (https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-69806), but the advisory places the vulnerable code in the dotnet watch Aspire service of the 9.0.3xx SDK, and the 9.0.1xx SDK released with .NET 9.0.20 (9.0.121) does not contain that service. The fix changes how dotnet watch passes the project's launch environment to the application (https://github.com/dotnet/sdk/commit/d4099745c1b346ea90cfee17f2361a4cd0bbf5b9). DHI dotnet9-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 9 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, which builds the 9.0.1xx SDK band: the SDK in dotnet9-runtime-bootstrap is 9.0.113 to 9.0.124 across the builds. Scanned all 242 packages of the eleven published builds (9.0.12-r0, 9.0.13-r0, 9.0.14-r0, 9.0.15-r0, 9.0.16-r0, 9.0.17-r0, 9.0.18-r0, 9.0.20-r0, 9.0.21-r0, 9.0.22-r0 and 9.0.23-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the debug packages and the files inside the nupkg, zip and tar.gz archives they hold. In the 9.0.1xx sources the dotnet watch project does not include the Aspire service (the dotnet-watch project file imports the AspireService shared project in the 9.0.3xx band, for example at v9.0.300 and v9.0.316, but not at v9.0.113 or v9.0.124), and none of the dotnet-watch.dll copies shipped in the dotnet9-runtime-bootstrap packages contains any Aspire code or the AspireServerService type, while each holds the expected hot reload code. No package contains a Microsoft.WebTools.AspireService assembly or nupkg. So the vulnerable Aspire server code is not in this owner.
